items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bobby Timmons in the context of the Smithsonian anthology and soul jazz; the interviewee responds by discussing his own approach to categorizing his music, without mentioning any personal interaction or relationship with Timmons.

ctx.x: Oh. So he’s the baby son, I guess.
No, the baby is Bobby. Bobby’s not here yet.
